biggest_catch: New members only with no credit-union relationship in the prior six months — and you must route $1,000/month in direct deposits for two consecutive months, with the offer expiring September 30, 2026.
catches: New members only: no ownership interest in any First Commonwealth FCU account or membership within the previous six months; existing members are excluded.
Regular Share (membership) and Cashback Checking must be opened on the same day with promo code EARN400.

Receive at least $1,000 in direct deposits each month for two consecutive months, completed within 90 days of opening — consistently documented by multiple independent third-party sources; the official page references these as the offer's 'qualifying requirements.'
Primary member must enroll in Digital Banking to receive the bonus.
One bonus per member, regardless of the number of accounts opened.
The account must remain open, active, and in good standing through the bonus payout; closed, restricted, or charged-off accounts forfeit the bonus.
Employees, volunteers, and immediate family may be excluded.
Offer runs March 2–September 30, 2026 — it expires within days of this review.

steps: Confirm you have had no ownership interest in any First Commonwealth FCU account or membership in the previous six months.
Between March 2 and September 30, 2026, open a Regular Share (membership) and a Cashback Checking account on the same day using promo code EARN400.
Enroll the primary member in Digital Banking.
Within 90 days of opening, receive at least $1,000 in direct deposits in each of two consecutive months.
Keep the account open, active, and in good standing through the payout date.
Receive the $400 bonus, credited within the first two weeks of the month, approximately 30 days after all requirements are met.
